instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief for CardHaven Replacement Trail: The service tracks replacement requests for lost or damaged membership cards through status verification, preparation, collection, and closure. An active Member reports the card problem and requests a replacement. The Membership Clerk checks active status and records the replacement reason. After status confirmation, the Card Issuance Clerk prepares the card. The Card Issuance Clerk also marks it ready for collection.

output.summary: CardHaven Replacement Trail tracks replacement requests for lost or damaged membership cards through status verification, preparation, collection, and closure. An active Member reports the card problem and requests a replacement. The Membership Clerk verifies active status and records the replacement reason, and the Card Issuance Clerk prepares the card after confirmation and marks it ready for collection.
output.primary_goal: Track replacement requests for lost or damaged membership cards through status verification, preparation, collection, and closure.
key_capabilities: Report a lost or damaged membership card.
Prepare a replacement card after active status is confirmed.
Mark the replacement card ready for collection.

instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Overview of CardHaven Replacement Trail: It tracks replacement requests for lost or damaged membership cards through verification, preparation, collection, and closure. An active Member reports the problem and requests a replacement; the Membership Clerk verifies active status and records the reason. The Card Issuance Clerk prepares the card only after status confirmation. The Card Issuance Clerk marks it ready for collection, while the Collection Clerk records acknowledgement at handover. Closure is allowed only after handover is recorded, and fee collection and status renewal are excluded.

output.summary: CardHaven Replacement Trail tracks lost or damaged membership-card replacement requests through verification, preparation, collection, and closure. An active Member reports the problem and requests a replacement, and the Membership Clerk verifies active status and records the reason. The Card Issuance Clerk prepares the card only after status confirmation and marks it ready for collection, while the Collection Clerk records acknowledgement at handover. Closure is allowed only after handover is recorded; membership-fee collection and status renewal are excluded.
output.primary_goal: Track replacement requests for lost or damaged membership cards through verification, preparation, collection, and closure.
key_capabilities: Report a lost or damaged membership card.
Prepare a replacement card only after status confirmation.
Mark the replacement card ready for collection.
Close a request only after handover is recorded.
